create_frequency_limiter: create a FrequencyLimiter instance with a desired frequency in Hz to throttle loop iterations
use_limit_frequency: call limit_frequency to block the current thread until the desired period has elapsed since the last call
use_limit_frequency_async: await limit_frequency_async to non-blockingly delay an async loop to the desired frequency
use_calculate_remaining_time: call _calculate_remaining_time to get the remaining seconds before the next allowed iteration without sleeping
